Run yul_yyz_scraper.py, then load the CSV it writes above.
You can load multiple files at once (e.g. several days of runs) — they'll be merged automatically.
Ground transport assumption: $12 CAD each way for YYZ (downtown Toronto ⇄ Pearson), $0 for YTZ (Billy Bishop is downtown). Totals below always include this. "Best" compares bought-together (round-trip) vs. bought-separately (two one-ways) for the same pair of dates and airports, whichever is cheaper after transport.

Note: round-trip pricing is only used when the outbound and return airport match (e.g. YYZ→YYZ). Mixed-airport round-trips (fly into YYZ, home from YTZ) fall back to the separately-verified one-way sum, because the scraper's round-trip query has a known bug where it doesn't reliably price a differing return airport.
